question:
You are helping Nour, who runs a manufacturing company near Oujda. Here is what they told you, in their own order.
The company is choosing among 8 improvement projects, labelled P1 to P8.
The site's internet subscription costs 89 dollars per month.
Last year's total revenue was 1,470,000 dollars.
Each project is either done in full or not at all. Cost and expected yearly benefit:

| Project | Cost (dollars) | Yearly benefit (dollars) |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 18,000 | 32,000 |
| P2 | 75,000 | 129,000 |
| P3 | 13,000 | 12,000 |
| P4 | 76,000 | 65,000 |
| P5 | 15,000 | 16,000 |
| P6 | 24,000 | 20,000 |
| P7 | 53,000 | 72,000 |
| P8 | 80,000 | 133,000 |

The annual safety inspection last took place 3 months ago and found no issues.
A competitor opened a new site in Casablanca 6 months ago.
The total budget is 144,000 dollars.
Which projects should be funded to maximise the total yearly benefit?
answer_keys: The maximum total yearly benefit in dollars
objective_key: The maximum total yearly benefit in dollars
